WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT c.location, COUNT(DISTINCT q.raceId) AS race_count
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.location
),
shares AS (
  SELECT location, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM city_counts
),
mean_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT s.location, s.race_count, s.share, s.share - m.avg_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN mean_share m
WHERE s.share > m.avg_share
